topics.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Cyber, a dedicated hacking/defense AI
topics.why: It changes how fast security teams (and attackers) can find and patch software flaws, with OpenAI saying it's already helped surface vulnerabilities in Linux and Firefox.

topics.title: Tencent drops Hy4, a free 770B-parameter open-weights model with 1M-token context
topics.why: It's a sign the free, open-weight frontier is closing the gap with paid giants, which matters to anyone building on AI without a huge budget.

topics.title: OpenAI reportedly raises $11B more, pushing its valuation to $1.25 trillion
topics.why: It shows investors are still betting enormous sums on OpenAI despite ongoing doubts about AI profitability -- a number worth knowing if you're watching this boom.
